Why handloom

Made by hand

No two pieces are exactly alike, so slight variations in the weave are normal.

Comfortable to wear

Natural fibres let your skin breathe, even on warm days.

Supports weavers

Your purchase goes back to the families who weave the cloth.

How to order

  1. Tap “Order on WhatsApp” on the saree you like.
  2. We send you real photos in daylight and confirm it’s in stock.
  3. Pay by UPI and we ship it to you.
